seo.title: Rest Easy — Sleep Sounds for iPhone
seo.description: Sleep sounds for iPhone: mix rain, waves, fire, forest and noise, set a sleep timer that fades out gently, and see which sounds help you sleep. No accounts, no subscriptions.

hero.label: SLEEP SOUNDS
hero.title: Calm sounds for better sleep.
text: Mix rain, waves, a fire or soft noise, set a timer that fades them out, and drift off. Every sound is made on your iPhone as it plays. No sign-up, no subscriptions, nothing collected.

items.title: Eight Sounds, Made Live
items.text: Rain, ocean waves, forest, thunderstorm and fireplace, plus white, pink and brown noise. Each one is synthesized on your iPhone in stereo as it plays, so nothing loops and nothing downloads.

items.title: A Mixer for Your Night
items.text: Layer up to four sounds and set each one's volume. Sounds fade in and out, so nothing starts or stops with a jolt.

items.title: A Gentle Sleep Timer
items.text: From 15 minutes to 8 hours, with a fade of 30 seconds to 15 minutes. Then the sounds pause, and your mix is ready again tomorrow night.

items.title: Presets and a Widget
items.text: Save a mix as a preset and play it with one tap from the mixer, the menu or the Home Screen widget.

items.title: A Simple Sleep Log
items.text: Rate each night. Rest Easy notes the sounds you played and shows which ones you sleep best with.

items.title: Made for the Dark
items.text: Dark and Black by default, with nothing bright on screen while sound plays. Controls on the Lock Screen and in Control Center, and playback with the screen locked.

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Zero data collection.
text: No analytics. No ads. No tracking. Rest Easy makes no network requests. Your presets and sleep log stay on your iPhone.

cta.title: Sleep better tonight.
cta.text: Free on the App Store. No account required.
